scope: Approved first projectile encounter: two automatic kinetic turrets, one shield and clear blocked versus penetrating hits.
implementation: Instant pulse hits removed from both sides of the practice encounter. Traveling rounds resolve damage only on swept contact.
Two staggered automatic four-round turrets; source-authored aiming mounts, recoil, muzzle flashes, separated bright tracers and impact effects.
Standard rounds drain shields but fail reinforced armor without hull chip damage. Confirmed ineffective launches stop; fitting piercing rounds resumes effective fire.
Practice ammunition is unlimited and temporary. Modes affect future launches only; existing rounds keep their ammunition and trajectory.
One shield per side, armor-gated overflow, hull damage and terminal outcomes. No shield regeneration, inventory, upgrade ownership or general progression.
Fixed 120 Hz simulation with bounded frame input; swept sphere/rotated-ellipsoid and planet contacts. Moving ships can leave an incoming trajectory.
Fixed 160 projectile and 32 impact slots; instanced tracer/impact pools. Every active round drawn at every quality; secondary spark count changes.
Bridge/exterior/walking share the battle. Existing pause, routes, focus, reset, temporary-save and context-recovery behavior retained.

coverage: 1000 blocked attacks cause no hull chip damage
equal stationary outcomes at 30/144 presentation Hz

safety_tests.scope: Local fixtures only; no real asset transfer.

checks.name: Two automatic turrets launch visible separated rounds before any impact damage
Hold fire preserves flying rounds; both sides take damage only after arrival; old aim/trigger shortcuts remain absent
Standard rounds break the shield but cannot chip reinforced armor; fire control reports and stops ineffective new shots
Ammunition modes carry between bridge, walking and exterior; piercing rounds penetrate; pause and quality changes preserve projectile state
Piercing ammunition completes the automatic encounter; victory stops both guns and clears active rounds
Incoming kinetics collapse the single shield and damage hull; defeat stops flight; reset restores health and standard ammunition
Repeated practice reuses geometry and fixed pools; narrow controls fit and change ammunition and weapon mode
Range still limits new launches; return reacquires and resumes automatic fire
Graphics recovery preserves paused rounds; reload and travel clear temporary practice

pool_limits.limit: Repeated encounter reset checks, not a long-session or total GPU-memory benchmark.

rendered_review.method: Direct inspection of native-browser bridge, exterior, blocked, penetrating and narrow captures.
rendered_review.findings: Both foredeck streams are visible; shield/hull outcomes and practice ammunition controls are readable. Narrow panel fits and scrolls within the viewport. Rooms and ship art remain prototypes.

tooling_notes: First browser attempt used an exact accessible-name selector that omitted an arrow; fixed the test selector, then all nine groups passed.
Video capture initially lacked Playwright cached FFmpeg. Reused installed FFmpeg in ignored local tooling; no global installation or new runtime dependency.

knowledge_lookup.outcome: The broad search returned material from other engines/projects; the combined Three.js/projectile query was empty. No external implementation reused or research submitted. Search output was not fully reviewed; no catalog-wide absence claim.

limits: One stationary training target; coarse sphere/ellipsoid contacts. Own-hull occlusion, mount arcs and tracking-rate constraints remain unbuilt.
No missiles, countermeasures, automatic evasion, persistent damage, upgrade tree, sound or general tactical enemy AI.
Fixed-step equality checked for stationary encounters at two normal presentation cadences; severe frame gaps are clamped. Not a universal device-performance claim.
Isolated installed Chrome on this desktop. Physical phones/laptops, other browser engines, Electron runtime, long play and fresh agent sessions remain untested.
Earlier broad exploration/terrain/quality suites remain historical; this milestone ran model, safety and focused combat browser checks.
No commit, push, deployment, asset backup/restore, paid generation or research submission.

report.snapshot_observed: Round 28, no pending question, projectile gameplay video and four supporting images.
